activity.notes: William the Conqueror inherited Normandy after the death of his father Robert I in 1035 and remained Duke of Normandy until his death on 9 September 1087. His later conquest and kingship of England did not terminate his Norman rule, so ATLAS models Normandy and England as separate concurrent sovereign Activities for the same Person.

sources.title: The Royal Family — William I 'The Conqueror' (r. 1066-1087)
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records that William was recognized as heir to the Duchy of Normandy on his father's death in 1035 and remained connected to Normandy until his death on 9 September 1087.

sources.title: The Henry Project — William the Conqueror
sources.citation_text: The Henry Project explicitly lists William as Duke of Normandy from 1035 to 1087 and King of England from 1066 to 1087.
